description:
BryceTech is seeking a Senior Software Developer to join the Telemetry Processing and Apps (TPA) development team supporting the Payload Operations Integration Center (POIC), International Space Station (ISS), and Space Launch System (SLS) mission ground systems hosted at the Huntsville Operations Support Center (HOSC). The TPA team develops and supports ground systems responsible for data processing, storage, retrieval, and user experiences across current and future human spaceflight missions, including Artemis, Human Landing System (HLS), Extravehicular Activity and Human Surface Mobility (EHP), and Lunar Habitat Base initiatives. This position offers an opportunity to contribute to the modernization of mission-critical ground systems as they transition from Linux and Windows VMware environments to Kubernetes containers through a new HOSC OpenShift cluster and DevSecOps pipeline.
 Responsibilities
 Support the development and enhancement of telemetry processing and application systems supporting ISS, SLS, and Artemis missions
 Develop software using technologies such as Angular, ReactJS, C#, JavaScript, and other relevant programming languages
 Develop and maintain applications using .NET Core
 Support software development within Windows, Linux, and web-based environments
 Work with relational databases such as Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, and other modern high-performance databases
 Develop and support large-scale distributed systems with high availability and concurrent operation requirements
 Apply strong network programming skills to support mission ground system applications
 Develop and execute unit and automated testing to ensure software quality and reliability
 Support agile software development practices and containerized application environments
 Contribute to the modernization and migration of existing applications to Kubernetes/OpenShift environments
 Utilize GitLab and associated development and DevSecOps practices
 Capture, develop, and present technical information to support software development and program objectives
 Collaborate with the TPA development team and other stakeholders to address usability, performance, and operational requirements
 
 Experience in programming languages like Angular, ReactJS, C#, and JavaScript
 Experience with other relevant programming languages, especially functional ones
 Experience with .NET Core
 Experience with GitLab
 Familiarity with Windows, Linux, and especially web-based development environments
 Understanding of relational databases like Oracle, Microsoft SQL server, or similar modern high-performance databases, including open-source ones
 Experience with large distributed systems
 Strong network programming skills/experience
 Experience with unit testing
 Ability to capture, develop, and present technical information
 Automated testing experience
 Familiarity and or experience with agile development and containers
 
 BryceTech offers a full range of benefits, including competitive salary, a comprehensive health plan including dental and vision coverage, company-paid life & disability insurance policies, 401(k) plan with company match, and an educational reimbursement program.
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
